text: Completed capability composition. SlurmSite.fromCapabilities is transport-free; shared assemble consumes Scheduler[IO]; local CLI and overSsh use identical managed executor/store/staging/attachment semantics; DSL exposes Sojourn.slurm and slurmSsh. RemoteSlurm.scheduler preserves post-write disconnect as AcceptanceUnknown and emits distinct SSH diagnostic codes. Tests: scala-slurm full checkFormatting+test+evicted green (kernel 14, core 42, protocol 25, worker 30, managed 61, agent 11, SSH 22, plus CLI/local/observability/examples); Sojourn scalafmtCheckAll+test+evicted green (core 38, runtime 22, local TCK 25, DSL 9, Slurm capabilities/constructor examples 3). S3 remains open with one explicit external blocker: Docker desktop-linux daemon RPCs hang, so 18 disposable/authenticated Slurm laws are skipped.
